title: Vol structures
dek: Inner vol book: five standing Brent options structures (fade the wing, covered call, own the tail, call spread, risk reversal) with premiums, Greeks in plain labels, and cumulative P&L.

claims.text: At the October 23, 2026 ICE Brent settlements (January 2027 expiry, futures 111.70), the five standing vol structures mark: own the tail premium paid 2.41 per barrel, call spread paid 2.07, fade the wing collected 0.32, risk reversal collected 0.09, covered call collected 3.08. The covered call collects $105 per lot per day in rent (theta) at those marks.

Package Greeks at the same marks, per 1,000-barrel lot: covered call exposure 746 barrels, tail call fear sensitivity $97 per vol point, risk reversal exposure 506 barrels with fear sensitivity $1 per vol point.
